from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import time

app = FastAPI()

@app.get("/slow")
def slow_endpoint():
    time.sleep(5)
    return {"status": "done"}

client = TestClient(app)

def test_slow_endpoint():
    start = time.time()
    response = client.get("/slow")
    elapsed = time.time() - start
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert elapsed > 4.5  # Verify actual 5s delay

What is the issue with testing time-based behavior?
options: Time-based assertions make tests flaky
TestClient doesn't measure elapsed time
sleep() doesn't work in tests
No issue; timing is reliable
explanation: Elapsed time varies due to system load; use mock.patch('time.sleep') or freeze_time to control time, avoiding flaky tests.
